goal:
Help someone get ready for this: Launch a personal website in 2 weeks

Give a short, encouraging overview, then a checklist of concrete prep tasks — these are independent to-dos in priority order, NOT scheduled to specific days and NOT a timeline of events, just a flat checklist someone ticks off as they finish each one, so render it as an actual checklist with checkboxes. Include a couple of readiness stats if you can estimate them. Then offer 3-4 things they could explore next.

data_model.section_0_points:
• [ ] Define the primary goal (e.g., portfolio, blog, or resume)
• [ ] Choose and register a domain name
• [ ] Select a hosting provider or website builder (e.g., Squarespace, Carrd, WordPress)
• [ ] Draft core content: About Me, Services/Projects, and Contact info
• [ ] Gather high-quality photos and brand assets
• [ ] Design the layout and choose a color palette
• [ ] Build the site structure and add content pages
• [ ] Test mobile responsiveness and link functionality
• [ ] Set up a custom email address (optional)
• [ ] Connect a custom domain and publish
